title: 第10章 这是把她干哪去了？-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    美人向导轻声，“接近暴走了，他正在精神图景中自行压制他的精神体，已经无力去理会身体周遭的情况了。”

    “暴走？！”秦夙还不是很理解这种情况，“为什么暴走？是精神污染太严重了吗？可他身上也没出现异变啊？”

    美人向导还是有些意外的。

    虽然秦夙对哨兵暴走是一知半解，但她已经充分了解精神污染、异化这些现象，足以证明谢尘无带她时，是尽职尽责悉心教导过了。

    “哨兵一旦突破到S级，各方面能力都会发生质的飞跃，其中也包括自控力。别看他现在没有异变痕迹，其实他的精神污染程度，应该已经接近100%了。”

    秦夙听的冷汗直冒，诺亚的精神污染接近90%，就已经快变成一条巨型蝮蛇的样子。

    离颂这个100%……虽然没变形，但应该很严重吧！

    一定需要紧急疏导，不然会出大事的吧！

    美人向导还想再把事情说的更严重点，好让秦夙更加配合。

    可她才刚张嘴。

    秦夙已经不管三七二十一，踮脚抬手，把她两只小小的手掌，一左一右贴在了离颂脖子上！

    “离长官，离队长！”秦夙想着，离颂会夜访她宿舍，肯定是冲萧岑去的，他一定对萧岑充满执念，于是再次改口，“哥！”

    离颂身体一晃。

    像台生锈的机器一般，慢慢低头，漆黑的眼睛对准了秦夙。

    “解除你的精神力护盾，让我给你做疏导！”秦夙再喊，“你……听话，顺便把诺亚放开，别让他妨碍我！”

    秦夙那句“听话”，只不过是她的口头禅之一。

    毕竟在地球也有岁数了，职场上也混成了一个小管理，对不太乖的小下属她就会这么哄。

    现在把离颂当成不乖的小孩也是没办法，谁让她根本没学过怎么强行疏导？

    不对，好像治愈型是没法强行疏导的吧？只有战斗型向导才能……

    哎呀不管了！

    她两手够的高高的，在离颂脖颈间轻轻抚摸，“快，听话，先把诺亚放下，你这么提着他，多碍事啊！”

    离颂默然之中，手上力道竟然真的一松。

    “嗵！”的一声！

    诺亚重重摔在地上，发出一声凄厉的蛇鸣，“嘶——”

    美人向导当机立断，“送诺亚去疏导室，快！”
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The beauty guide whispered, "He is on the verge of going berserk. He is suppressing his mental body in the mental picture and is no longer able to care about the situation around his body."

"Rampage?!" Qin Su still didn't understand this situation very well, "Why did he run rampant? Is it because the mental pollution is too serious? But there is no change in his body?"

The beautiful guide was a little surprised.

Although Qin Su knew little about the sentinel rampage, she was fully aware of the phenomena of mental pollution and alienation, which proved that Xie Chenwu had taught her diligently and responsibly.

"Once the Sentinel breaks through to S level, all abilities will undergo a qualitative leap, including self-control. Even though he has no trace of mutation now, in fact, his mental pollution level should be close to 100%."

Qin Su broke into a cold sweat after hearing this. Noah's mental pollution was close to 90%, and he was about to turn into a giant viper.

Li Song is 100%... Although he has not deformed, it should be serious!

Emergency evacuation must be needed, otherwise something big will happen!

The beauty guide also wanted to make the matter more serious so that Qin Su could cooperate more.

But she just opened her mouth.

Qin Su no longer cared about anything else, he stood on tiptoe and raised his hands, placing her two small palms on Li Song's neck, one on the left and the other on the right!

"Sir Li, Captain Li!" Qin Su thought that Li Song would visit her dormitory at night, and it must be for Xiao Cen. He must be obsessed with Xiao Cen, so he changed his mind again, "Brother!"

Li Song’s body swayed.

Like a rusty machine, he slowly lowered his head and aimed his dark eyes at Qin Su.

"Remove your mental shield and let me guide you!" Qin Su shouted again, "You...be obedient and let Noah go by the way. Don't let him hinder me!"

Qin Su’s phrase “obedient” is just one of her mantras.

"After all, she has been on earth for a long time, and she has become a small manager in the workplace. She will be so coaxing to her subordinates who are not very well-behaved.

Now there is no way to treat Li Song as a naughty child. Who knows that she has never learned how to forcefully guide her?

No, it seems that the healing type cannot be forcibly diverted, right?Only combat guides can...

Never mind it!

She reached up with both hands and gently stroked Li Song's neck, "Quick, obedient, put Noah down first. It's such an inconvenience for you to carry him like this!"

In Li Song's silence, the strength in his hands actually relaxed.

"Boom!" A sound!

Noah fell heavily to the ground and let out a shrill snake cry, "Hiss——"

The beauty guide made a quick decision, "Send Noah to the counseling room, quickly!"
